goal: Authorize a repository-local controlled publisher rollout and one-time trust bootstrap barrier before any autonomous ordinary source mutation in hwm-lab.

verified_facts.statement: P0A started from protected hwm-control/main 6abdbdac283b0849d3cd2429ab6985d9762c66c7, hwm-lab/main 74d27e855b9faba7c934d306af0be507f83ac5fe, and hwm_predictor/main 8fd669336b36064e842252d69fb4016cc526a9d4; completed Issue #72 was the only predecessor.

Protected hwm-control already contains the reviewed hwm-publish-request/bootstrap-v1 and hwm-publish-result/bootstrap-v1 contracts, ADR 0001, controlled publisher implementation and security tests, with explicit exact-head ordinary CI dispatch.
Protected hwm-lab at 74d27e855b9faba7c934d306af0be507f83ac5fe has only repository bootstrap CI and no controlled task-branch publisher or equivalent exact-head publisher dispatch surface.

P0A Issue #78 and blocked installation barrier Issue #79 were created after duplicate search found no unfinished equivalent tasks; Issue #73 was moved from ready to blocked on completed #79 and remains unclaimed.

Controlled publisher request pub-i10-0078-claim-01 moved only BUILD_STATUS.json to claim commit 8972325519e6578c6b209f9cd7736126e96306ea with request fingerprint 3f15e9a7112e224c0d23bcb5ddcc406e48c16d54ebc352cdde283f6c7d7fc228; publisher workflow run 32053324060 failed only while posting its result comment because GitHub API returned HTTP 503 after CAS and CI dispatch.

Infrastructure CI run 32053356795 was dispatched on exact claim commit 8972325519e6578c6b209f9cd7736126e96306ea, verified exact checkout, and failed solely because the repository gate required knowledge-deltas/I10-0078.json while I10-0078 was active.

Controlled publisher request pub-i10-0078-claim-kd-01 then added only knowledge-deltas/I10-0078.json at commit 92f9ed31b7d21b200896b18a0db39eb5e146ac31 with request fingerprint 97fae30215582beb81358c483fd3f99cb93e3001c42a73e59d240abfac382d34; publisher run 32053617337 again encountered GitHub API HTTP 503 while producing/delivering the post-CAS result, and no Infrastructure CI run was created for that exact head.

decisions.decision: Keep bootstrap-v1 repository-local and require a separate architecture/contract installation barrier before hwm-lab ordinary source publication.
decisions.rationale: The existing hwm-control publisher is intentionally repository-bound; widening its token into a cross-repository writer would violate least privilege.

decisions.decision: Authorize only a narrow one-time bootstrap transport for publisher self-installation in a target repository, with exact protected-main base, allowlisted installation paths, protected PR, exact CI/readback and no direct-main or ruleset bypass.
decisions.rationale: The target repository cannot use its controlled publisher before that publisher exists, so installation is an explicit trust bootstrap rather than ordinary publication.

decisions.decision: Treat repeated generic/manual source publication as a regression after repository-local publisher installation.
decisions.rationale: Ordinary source mutation must return to the reviewed versioned controlled transport once the target repository can enforce it locally.

decisions.decision: Do not use a manual workflow dispatch or alternate source writer to compensate for publisher-side GitHub API transport failures.
decisions.rationale: Exact-head CI association is part of bootstrap-v1 publisher semantics and must remain attributable to the controlled publisher path.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use the ordinary hwm-control GITHUB_TOKEN as a cross-repository hwm-lab writer.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The current token is repository-scoped and must not be widened across repository trust boundaries.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Introduce a PAT, deploy key or GitHub App private key as part of P0A.
rejected_alternatives.reason: No separate security decision or demonstrated necessity authorizes a long-lived or cross-repository credential.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Install hwm-lab publisher or begin Graphify implementation inside P0A.
rejected_alternatives.reason: P0A is an architecture/contract authorization barrier only; installation is Issue #79 and Graphify implementation remains blocked in Issue #73.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Manually dispatch Infrastructure CI after the partial publisher transaction.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would bypass the required publisher-to-exact-head-CI association instead of proving the controlled transport end to end.
